text: Small one: What is the seat count for Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines? I need it for the QBR deck.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 sets Quarrendon Freight Lines at 185 seats for Pemberline Dock. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01.

I also told her that Amendment No. 3, signed on 2026-09-22, raises the count to 230 seats, but not until 2027-01-01. That means 185 is still the current count as of today (2026-10-14), which matters for her deck.

Seat counts are operational facts, not finance figures, and Dana is on the North team that handles Quarrendon, so no approval was needed. The answer came from the North team's Quarrendon contract records. I left out any pricing or discount terms.
